tools.name: smartaccounts_get_vendor_balance

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_payments
tools.description: Bank and cash payments from clients and to vendors (purchasesales/payments:get): date, partner, account, currency, amount, optionally the rows (which invoices were paid). Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_ledger_entries
tools.description: General ledger entries of every type (general/entries:get): manual entries, invoices, payments, VAT returns, depreciation. Filter by date, type, text or payment status. Paged (100 per page). The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_accounts
tools.description: The chart of accounts: code, type (ASSET, LIABILITY, INCOME, EXPENSE), Estonian and English description. Use the codes in ledger entries. (settings/accounts:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_vat_rates
tools.description: VAT codes: vatPc code, percentage, descriptions, whether active for sales or purchases, accounts. Use vatPc in client and invoice rows. (settings/vatpcs:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts: name (used as accountName in payments), ledger account, currency, IBAN, SWIFT. (settings/bankaccounts:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_cash_accounts
tools.description: The company's cash registers: name (used as accountName in payments), ledger account, currency. (settings/cashaccounts:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

tools.name: smartaccounts_list_payment_methods
tools.description: Payment methods: name, ledger account, whether cash. (settings/paymentmethods:get). Not paged. The vendor limit is 60 requests per minute and 1000 per 24 hours; every call here is one request.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "smartaccounts_list_articles" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "smartaccounts_create_client" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
